description: Everything recorded since a date, for a model whose knowledge ends at a cutoff: price changes, new items, removals and retirements, newest first, each with its UTC date, the previous good snapshot, the source URL and a permanent link to the item. counts are for the whole period (not just the page); gaps names the sources that are stopped now, with the day they stopped (never filled in; outages that recovered are not recorded); record_begins says how far back the record goes. summary=true returns the largest percent moves per category (at most 40 entries) in one answer, ordered by size of the move, not by price. Paging: pass next_cursor back as cursor. Entries carry recorded values only, never a current price. Returns an error object for a bad date or filter. Same data as GET /v1/changes-since. Use this one to page through every entry or to filter by category and kind (price_change, new_item, removed_or_stopped, retirement); for a first look at what changed since your cutoff, with counts, scope llm/gpu/vps and the gaps, call what_changed_since instead.
